def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = 'data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_State_Top_Ten_Report_Categories.csv'
    # The file has a title row and blank row before the real header.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=None, dtype=str)
    # Find the header row containing the expected column names
    header_idx = df.index[(df[0] == 'State') & (df[1] == 'Category')].tolist()
    header_idx = header_idx[0] if header_idx else 2
    data = df.iloc[header_idx+1:, :4].copy()
    data.columns = ['State', 'Category', 'Reports', 'Percentage']

    # Drop footer / note rows and blank lines
    data = data.dropna(how='all')
    data = data[~data['State'].astype(str).str.startswith(('Percentages are based', 'Source:'), na=False)]

    # Clean numeric fields (keep as nullable integers where possible)
    data['Reports'] = (data['Reports']
                       .astype(str)
                       .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
                       .str.strip())
    data['Reports'] = pd.to_numeric(data['Reports'], errors='coerce')

    data['Percentage'] = data['Percentage'].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Drop any rows missing key fields
    data = data.dropna(subset=['State', 'Category'])
    data['State'] = data['State'].astype(str).str.strip()
    data['Category'] = data['Category'].astype(str).str.strip()
    return data

def process(top10):
    import pandas as pd

    df = top10.copy()
    target = "Prizes, Sweepstakes and Lotteries"

    # Robust match: trim whitespace and compare case-sensitively after normalization
    df['Category_norm'] = df['Category'].astype(str).str.strip()

    states = (
        df.loc[df['Category_norm'] == target, 'State']
          .astype(str).str.strip()
          .dropna()
          .unique()
    )

    out = pd.DataFrame({'State': sorted(states)})
    out['has_prizes_sweepstakes_lotteries_in_top10_2024'] = True
    return out
